title: Metabolite Extraction and Analysis Process
summary: This cluster describes a process for metabolite extraction and analysis. Metabolite Extraction employs literature and equipment from Novogene Co. and involves steps such as homogenizing cell pellets with liquid nitrogen, centrifugation, and using various chemicals and protocols. The process produces supernatant, which is then used to obtain methanol. Metabolomics analysis is performed on fermentation solution samples using various mass spectrometry techniques and platforms, including LC-MS/MS, provided by Novogene Co.
